news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.71 loss per share (vs ₹0.97 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.71 loss per share (improved from ₹0.97 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹383.8m (up 311% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹210.3m (loss narrowed 27% from 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 109% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 25% growth forecast for the Real Estate industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 31% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 55% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Earnings have declined by 27% per year over the past 5 years. Minor Risk Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (6.9% average weekly change).
